snippet.title: GG-Party - Mini Games Trailer (pre-alpha)
snippet.description:
This is the first Mini-Game Trailer for GG-Party. #gg #ggparty
This is real in-game raw footage. We acknowledge it's raw and there's still a lot of polishing to do. We also know you're eager to see the Open World and the Open World Mode as well. However, we believe it's too early to show you that, but rest assured, we will tease the open world to you soon.

Missing mini-games in this teaser: Quads Race, Jet-Ski Race, and Paintshop.

If you like it, go to Steam and add it to your wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796340/GGParty
